2. What was the hardest part of your work?

I never thought it was difficult. It was my first challenge, and the directors supported me so completely that I can only remember working with happiness and happiness.

If I dare to mention one, I was writing a erotic scene, but when my Magnum missile didn't fire, I was afraid I would be impotent at a young age.


3. What is the most memorable part of your work?

When I wrote down the script, the material did not come out. At that time, the director showed me some of the content being produced. As soon as I saw it, I remembered yelling "Uhhhhho !!" and writing out 20,000 characters in an hour.

From my ten years as a writer, I've never written a document so quickly.


4. I think you were new to game script work. What are your thoughts?


"Frankly, at first, I was more afraid than I expected. I'm sure that there are many shortcomings because I'm a new writer, and I think the director would get angry. I was pleased to see it and I was able to gain a sense of confidence.

In addition to that, everyone who played the game would like to give a positive rating, so I would be less satisfied than this. I just want to repeat the word thank you!


5. What if you recently introduced interesting games, interesting movies, or anime?


I enjoy the game a lot. Among them, I am addicted to the game "Fate / Grand Order". I think the game was also very influential when writing sentences.

I haven't seen anime lately, but I was most impressed with "expulsion of paradise". Despite being a movie version, while showing some storytelling, Angela's "Chora chase scene" that I showed at the beginning still remains in my memory.


6. What theme did you want to include in the story?


In fact, we usually live a lot of conversations. Each person in the story has a past. Of course, that memory often hurts. Especially in a fantasy world like "Israfil Continent".

Each heroine in this game has a "painful past". The theme is that the heroines who have overcome the trauma advance to the future with the main character, "Soma".


7. What character do you love the most?

From the beginning I really liked Remuriel. Imagine your sharp eyes suddenly hugging your tail and sleeping happily, isn't it cute?

Over the course of the story, I was completely absorbed in the charm of Bercino. Even though she is called the Empress, she has such a light tone, and she is a fossil-like girl who can walk further. I think this gap is too adorable.


8. What's my boom these days


Recently, I am exploring delicious foods here and there. Even if you can't go to a lot of people because of the coronavirus, the satisfaction you feel when you find a hidden gourmet can't be changed.

Enjoy delicious food, play home and play Pego (FGO). Thanks to the reissue of the Kudakuda event, we are welcoming a happy Devil King Nob.


9. Finally, a word to the users.


First of all, thank you very much for purchasing and playing our game. It's a story or script that has a lot of missing parts, but it was praised as interesting and interesting, and the blood well-being index has already reached the critical point.

Actually, I had many worries while writing the story. When I became a little more straightforward, I was not confident.

Is it okay to write this as it is? Is it possible to solve it a little more interestingly?

However, I was encouraged by the encouragement of Mr. PD, the help and great advice of my colleagues, and the support given during the pre-determined period. I'm really happy to have such a great experience.

"Innocent" ends with a story of eight people, but not the story of Islafil. Expect hero stories that will continue to be fun and a little erotic.


We pray that your "WISH" will come true.
